Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgBiotin 30μgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin C 100mgZinc 8.5mgFolate 400μgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

비타샷Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 주식회사 아리너스 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 15mg Niacin, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 아리너스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per serving

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미를 가지고, 이미, 이취가 없는 연노랑색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 고온 다습, 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 50μg of Biotin, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 50μg of Vitamin B12, 50mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 17mg of Zinc, 1700μg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 50mg Niacin, 50μg Biotin, 50mg Vitamin B1, 50μg Vitamin B12, 50mg Vitamin B2, 50mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 17mg Zinc, 1700μg Folate, 50mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
